items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Who's Douglas Williams that plays clarinet? Is that the same guy? Oh, no.

ctx.x: All over. Did you know Leo Watson? Sure, I know him all over. But, uh, but, his name ain't been Doug. Well, now, who plays clarinet?
Who's Douglas Williams that plays clarinet? Is that the same guy? Oh, no.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
